stem:
Imran matches large-number names to powers of 10. He knows 1 crore $=10^{7}$ in the Indian system and 1 million $=10^{6}$ in the international system.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: 1 crore equals 1 million because both names are large.

teacher.key_rationale: 10^7 / 10^6 = 10, so 1 crore = 10 million. Swapping the powers mislabels crore or million. Equating the names only because both are large ignores the powers of 10.
